title: vSFT: Learning to Verbally Tune Agents at Test Time
abstract: arXiv:2611.34440v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly improved via agentic reinforcement learning, which can be on-policy but suffers from expensive rollouts and sparse rewards, limiting its application at test time. In this paper, we present a verbally Supervised Fine-Tuning (vSFT) framework that enables the conjunction of dense feedback in natural language and weight updates at test time. Specifically, our vSFT forms a closed loop between an agent and a supervisor via a hypernetwork, in which the supervisor generates verbal supervision from the agent's failed trajectories, and the hypernetwork converts that supervision into low-rank weight updates to tune the agent. We validate that this test-time in-parameter evolving process outperforms both its in-context counterparts and prevalent reinforcement learning methods. translated_title: vSFT：在测试时通过语言反馈微调智能体
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体越来越多地通过智能体强化学习进行改进，这种方法可以采用在策略方式，但存在 rollout 成本高昂和奖励稀疏的问题，限制了其在测试时的应用。本文提出了一种语言监督微调框架，实现了自然语言密集反馈与测试时权重更新的结合。具体而言，我们的vSFT通过一个超网络在智能体与监督者之间构建闭环：监督者从智能体的失败轨迹中生成语言监督信号，超网络则将这些监督信号转化为低秩权重更新以调整智能体。我们验证了这种测试时的参数内演化过程优于上下文学习对应方法以及主流强化学习方法。特别地，基于Qwen3-4B的vSFT在ALFWorld上的成功率分别比GRPO和Reflexion高出8.7%和13.9%，并比另一方法高出4.8%（原文摘要此处截断）。
tldr: 提出vSFT框架，通过超网络将监督者基于智能体失败轨迹生成的自然语言反馈转化为低秩权重更新，实现测试时的参数内演化，在ALFWorld等任务上性能超越GRPO和Reflexion等主流强化学习方法。
